description: This file contains benchmark classes for message queueing performance testing in the Orleans project, specifically targeting ADO.NET with SQL Server.

classes.name: SqlServerMessageQueueingBenchmark
classes.description: A derived benchmark class that sets up the SQL Server environment for message queueing performance tests.

classes.name: MessageQueueingBenchmark
classes.description: An abstract base class implementing common benchmarking logic for message queueing scenarios, parameterized by database invariants and queues.

methods.name: GlobalSetup
methods.description: Sets up the database connection pools for the benchmark.

methods.name: GlobalSetup (in MessageQueueingBenchmark)
methods.description: Initializes payload, queue IDs, and database connections before running benchmarks.

methods.name: IterationSetup
methods.description: Prepares the database for each iteration by truncating the message table.

methods.name: QueueStreamMessage
methods.description: Performs concurrent queue message operations to measure performance.
